_comment: RealESRGAN x4plus on a still. 1.inputs.image is the source (it must already be staged in ComfyUI/input), 4.inputs.filename_prefix the destination. x4 is the model's native factor and the only one it does well; ask for 2x by resizing afterwards rather than by half-running the model.
_notes: the same weights post.py uses for the film's 2x master, so a card and a frame get the same treatment
ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles internally; a 4096x5120 output is fine on this card
